title: Hawkes-Driven OTC Market Making: Volterra-Riccati Approximation
abstract: arXiv:2608.02002v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We formulate an over-the-counter (OTC) market-making problem in which request-for-quote (RFQ) arrivals are modelled by general Hawkes kernels and fills are controlled thinnings of the exogenous request flow. The modelling choice is motivated by spot-FX RFQ data: after filtering and transforming to seasonality-adjusted RFQ activity time, two-way activity in major currency pairs exhibits large fitted branching ratios and multi-scale persistence. For general Hawkes kernels the control problem is path-dependent: the relevant state contains the order-flow history, or equivalently the forward curve of conditional future RFQ intensities. Exact Markovian lifting is available for exponential kernels, but it becomes high-dimensional for mixtures of exponentials and impractical for long-memory kernels. We therefore develop a hierarchy of Volterra-Riccati approximations. The first level replaces random future request flow by its conditional Volt

translated_title: 基于霍克斯过程的场外市场做市：Volterra-Riccati近似方法
translated_abstract: 本文构建了一个场外交易（OTC）市场做市问题，其中报价请求（RFQ）的到达由一般霍克斯核函数建模，而成交则被视为外生请求流的受控细化。这一建模选择受到即期外汇（spot-FX）RFQ数据的启发：在过滤并转换为季节性调整的RFQ活动时间后，主要货币对的双向活动表现出较大的拟合分支比率和多尺度持续性。对于一般霍克斯核函数，控制问题具有路径依赖性：相关状态包含订单流历史，或等价地，条件未来RFQ强度的前向曲线。对于指数核函数，精确马尔可夫提升是可行的，但对于指数混合核函数，它会变得高维，且对于长记忆核函数不切实际。因此，我们开发了一个Volterra-Riccati近似层次。第一层将随机未来请求流替换为其条件Volt（截断部分）。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的OTC市场做市模型，使用霍克斯过程建模RFQ到达，并开发了Volterra-Riccati近似方法来解决路径依赖的控制问题，以应对高维和长记忆挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel OTC market-making model using Hawkes processes for RFQ arrivals and develops a Volterra-Riccati approximation hierarchy to address path-dependent control problems, overcoming high-dimensionality and long-memory challenges.
